lines.text: Hi, this is refriGator, a student-built AI assistant, not an official SF State service. An AI turns what you say into text to check CalFresh; the call audio isn't recorded. Okay to start? Say yes, or press one.
Great. Are you an undergrad or a grad student at SF State, and how many units are you taking this term?
I'm an SF State undergrad, a junior, and I'm taking 12 units.
Got it. How old are you, and who do you live with?
I'm 20, and I live with two roommates.
Thanks. Do you buy and cook food with your roommates, or separately?
Thanks. About how much do you earn a month from work before taxes, not counting financial aid, and does anyone give you cash?
I work at the campus library, about 900 a month. Nobody gives me cash.
Got it — about nine hundred dollars a month from work. What's your share of the rent each month?
Okay — eleven hundred dollars a month. Another quick one. Does anyone, like a parent, pay part of your rent straight to your landlord?
